name: adr183-continuation-native-19
result: First ADR-187 run. The continuation stopped at the first configuration role: 'worker/roles-provision/role:configuration-fleet after current=0s claim=1.75s role=3.101s stop=3.101s, 1.899s, operation 1.899s left (unavailable)'. The first attempt overran its original five-second claim, and every replay then found a non-fresh claim without a role, which stays lookup-only by design. Cause: one configuration role took three full source proofs, 118 API requests and 4.55 s in the unit fixture at 20 QPS, so run 18's pass had almost no margin. The configuration role source is independent of the ADR-187 resource producer. ADR-188 removes the completion's third proof (83 requests, 3.25 s). The replay checks were not reached.
scope: Real kind API, OpenBao, SeaweedFS S3 and PostgreSQL. The other two subtests passed.
